giver: The Crafters' guild: masons in every village take commissions; Master Joiner Odile Brask keeps the guild workshop in Reece and gives the key commissions
feel: Commissions to furnish and rebuild villages, paid by people you meet, while the guild workshop in Reece grows from an empty barn into a hall with storage, a band and a festival. Each commission leaves something visible behind.

quests.title: Apprentice Papers
quests.summary: The guild's workshop in Reece is an empty barn and Odile needs hands. Sign on with a mason and prove you can join wood: make a Handcrafted table and two chairs for the bare hall.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a hammer and a stack of planks

quests.title: Benches and Boards
quests.summary: Fit out the workshop: workbenches, Supplementaries item shelves for tools and a notice board where commissions will be pinned.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a notice board with the first commission on it

quests.title: A Home Again
quests.summary: A widow's cottage was stripped bare by thieves. Make her a fancy bed, a cupboard, a nightstand and cushions, and set them in place; she judges whether it feels like home.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a jar of berry jam and her late husband's tools

quests.title: A Place for Everything
quests.summary: The workshop floor is a mess of loose materials. Make sacks, jars and safes and sort the guild's stock into them, labelled.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a key and a safe

quests.title: Sleeping Rough, Sleeping Well
quests.summary: Guild members travelling to far commissions sleep on the ground. Sew Comforts sleeping bags and hammocks with rope and nail and hand them out at the guild camp.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, your own hammock

quests.title: Light the Square
quests.summary: Zombies keep wandering into the village square at night. Build a Torchmaster megatorch at its centre and hold one night without a single spawn inside its ring.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a stack of lanterns

quests.title: Last Orders
quests.summary: A tavern keeper wants her old tavern refitted before the travelling season: a grandfather clock, a cash register, benches, curtains and a fish tank, all from [Let's Do] Furniture.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, free meals at the tavern and a boat in a jar

quests.title: Somewhere to Sit
quests.summary: With the square lit, the elders want somewhere to sit and talk. Furnish it with Another Furniture benches, flower boxes, awnings and lamps.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a dozen flowers and the elders' gratitude

quests.title: The Washed-Out Bridge
quests.summary: Spring floods took the bridge over Reece's river and farmers are wading across. Rebuild it with Macaw's Bridges piers, rails and bridge lanterns.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, the farmers' thanks in crops and a stack of stone bricks

quests.title: The Travelling Joiner
quests.summary: Odile gives you her old backpack pattern. Make a Sophisticated Backpack and fit it with a crafting upgrade so you can build on site.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a stack upgrade

quests.title: Fresh Paint
quests.summary: The shop signs have faded to nothing and nobody can find the baker. Mix dye bottles, repaint the signs and hang the right wares on each shopfront so a newcomer can find every trade.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a set of dye bottles

quests.title: The Engineer's Blueprints
quests.summary: The guild's founder lived in an engineer's tower out in the wilds and left plans for a better workshop. Climb the tower and bring back his blueprints.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, blueprints and the founder's journal

quests.title: Two Rooms, One Judge
quests.summary: A swaggering carpenter from a rival village turns up (encounter) and challenges the guild: each furnishes an identical empty room and the villagers vote on the better one.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, the rival's prize chisel set

quests.title: Raise the Ruin
quests.summary: Refugees from a burned town want to go home. Find the ruined town, clear it, and rebuild three houses and a bridge with furniture so the first families can move back in.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, the town's restored bell

quests.title: The Warehouse
quests.summary: The founder's blueprints show a warehouse under the workshop. Dig it out and wire it with Obscura's storage: inventory cables, connectors and a storage terminal.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a crafting terminal

quests.title: The Sorting Room
quests.summary: Odile commissions a sorting room where every delivery sorts itself: item filters, tag filters and hoppers into the right crates. When it works, she gives you her prototype attractor that never made it into production.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, Universal Attractor

quests.title: Pockets Within Pockets
quests.summary: Upgrade the travelling pack for long jobs: magnet, pickup, auto-smelting and compacting upgrades.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a refill upgrade

quests.title: Strings and Skins
quests.summary: The village band lost its instruments in a fire. Make a lute, a flute, a tiny drum and a trumpet from Immersive Melodies and deliver one to each musician.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a vielle of your own

quests.title: The Concert
quests.summary: Build a stage in the square with buntings, flags and seating, then join the band and play a melody through for the gathered villagers.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a music disc and confetti poppers

quests.title: Dressed for the Guild
quests.summary: A guild member should look the part even in armour. Make the guild's leather apron outfit and wear it in your cosmetic armour slots over your real gear when you report to Odile.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, dyed guild leathers

quests.title: Ginger in the Snow
quests.summary: Winter is coming and the children want a gingerbread house. Find wild ginger, grow it, bake gingerbread and build the house in the square, doors and frosting included.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, gingerbread cookies and candy canes

quests.title: Downhill
quests.summary: Build a sled and enter the snowy village's downhill race; beat the local champion to the bottom.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a snow globe

quests.title: The Winter Festival
quests.summary: The guild runs the winter festival in a festive village: hang wreaths and glow lights, wrap presents for every villager and set up the gingerbread stalls before the first night.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, prismatic glow lights and eggnog

quests.title: Lamps for the Dark Side
quests.summary: The guild wants a safe workshop camp in the Nether. Make a dreadlamp and feral flare lanterns and light the camp so it stays free of spawns.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, frozen pearls

quests.title: Restart the Lift
quests.summary: The engineer's tower had a lift. Fix it with Supplementaries pulleys, cranks and cog blocks so it runs from the cellar to the roof.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a wrench and the founder's last blueprint

quests.title: Anywhere in the Workshop
quests.summary: The warehouse has outgrown walking. Build a wireless terminal and pull items from the network from anywhere in Reece.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, an advanced wireless terminal blueprint

quests.title: Bridge to the Island
quests.summary: A fishing hamlet on an island off the coast wants a stone balustrade bridge to the mainland, long enough to need piers in deep water.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, prismarine and the hamlet's catch

quests.title: The Guild's Trophies
quests.summary: Every great guild hall has trophies. Make Handcrafted trophies from what you've hunted (a bear, a blaze, a wither skeleton) and mount them in the hall.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a stack of experience bottles

quests.title: The Guild Hall
quests.summary: Build the guild hall from the founder's last blueprint: a hall fit for the guild, furnished with all three furniture traditions, a stage, the warehouse below and the trophy wall.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a guild banner

quests.title: A Pack That Never Wears Out
quests.summary: Finish your masterwork backpack: netherite tier with an everlasting upgrade and an inception upgrade.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, an advanced tool swapper upgrade

quests.title: After the Ruin
quests.summary: With the monster in the desert gone, the occupied village it held can be rebuilt. Lead the guild there, repair its houses and furnish them for the survivors coming home.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, the survivors' heirloom

quests.title: Master of the Guild
quests.summary: Odile steps aside and names you master of the guild, handing over the founder's tools reforged for you.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, the Founder's Masterwork set (named netherite axe and pickaxe: Efficiency V, Unbreaking III, Mending, Fortune III on the pickaxe)
